title: Colorectal Cancer Segmentation with Adaptive Augmentation and Multi-Resolution Ensemble Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most deadly and third most common cancer, and the leading cause of death among gastrointestinal cancers. Early diagnosis is crucial for the treatment of this cancer and increasing the survival rates. Although CRC is more common in developed regions, its occurrence is also increasing in developing regions as well. CRC diagnosis relies on histopathology assessment post-biopsy. Automated deep learning algorithms can significantly reduce diagnosis time, enhancing efficiency and supporting timely clinical decisions.   We present an automated segmentation pipeline for whole-slide histopathology images that labels tumor grades 1-3 and normal mucosa. It utilizes dense prediction transformers with various encoder backbones, overlapping patches, and test-time augmentation. translated_title: 基于自适应增强与多分辨率集成模型的结直肠癌分割
translated_abstract: 结直肠癌（CRC）是第二致命、第三常见的癌症，也是胃肠道癌症中导致死亡的主要原因。早期诊断对于该癌症的治疗和提高生存率至关重要。尽管结直肠癌在发达地区更为常见，但其发病率在发展中地区也在不断上升。结直肠癌的诊断依赖于活检后的组织病理学评估。自动化深度学习算法可以显著缩短诊断时间，提高效率并支持及时的临床决策。我们提出了一种针对全切片组织病理学图像的自动化分割流程，用于标注1-3级肿瘤和正常黏膜。该方法利用了具有多种编码器骨干网络的密集预测变换器（DPT）、重叠图像块以及测试时增强。由大语言模型指导的自适应增强策略进一步改善了训练效果。最佳模型通过软投票方式进行集成。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型指导的自适应数据增强策略与多分辨率软投票集成模型的自动化分割流程，可对全切片组织病理学图像中的结直肠癌肿瘤分级（1-3级）及正常黏膜进行精确分割，从而加速诊断并支持及时的临床决策。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated segmentation pipeline that combines an LLM-guided adaptive augmentation policy with multi-resolution ensemble models (via soft voting) to accurately segment tumor grades 1-3 and normal mucosa in whole-slide histopathology images, enabling faster colorectal cancer diagnosis and timely clinical decisions.
